scope: static source audit only; no guest execution, no acceptance, no frozen code changes

binary_reported_by_parent.gap: Publisher commit metadata verified; raw source blocked by anti-bot page; GitHub publisher mirror does not expose this commit. Findings below are upstream v11.1.0, with v11.0.0 comparison, not binary authentication.

breakpoint.source_version: upstream v11.1.0 tcg-accel-ops.c and bpt_helper.c; v11.0.0 cpu-exec.c
breakpoint.mechanism: Z1 maps to cpu_breakpoint_insert(..., BP_GDB) for every CPU; PC match exits CPU loop with EXCP_DEBUG. No guest instruction patch or guest DR write on this insertion path.
breakpoint.qualification: Guest BP_CPU at overlapping PC may independently trigger #DB in breakpoint_handler. Require no overlapping guest CPU breakpoint/watchpoint; distinguish debugger stop from guest exception. Resume and instruction re-execution behavior need bounded runtime checks.

rsp_hmp.rsp_real_fields: EAX..EIP EFLAGS selectors CR0/2/3/4 FPCW FPSW logical ST0..7 XMM0..7 MXCSR
rsp_hmp.hmp_adds: GDT IDT LDT TR descriptors, DR0..3 DR6 DR7, abridged FTW and physical FPR0..7
rsp_hmp.x87_order: RSP ST(i)=physical FP[(i+TOP)&7]; HMP FPRi is physical. TOP=(FSW>>11)&7. FTW bit i is physical nonempty. Full two-bit tag: empty=3, exponent=0 and mantissa=0 => zero=1; exponent in {0,0x7fff} or integer bit clear => special=2; otherwise valid=0. Do not rotate physical FTW.
rsp_hmp.base_width: HMP segment cache base width follows CS64, so x86_64 compatibility mode truncates LDT/TR and segment bases to 32 bits. GDT/IDT width follows LMA. RSP FS/GS base and controls use target width. Never silently truncate or infer high zero bits from HMP.
rsp_hmp.epoch: All vCPUs must be stopped; identify selected CPU, retain stop/resume transcript. A text parser cannot establish a coherent stopped epoch.

cpu_vmstate.available: GPRs EIP EFLAGS hflags; physical FP registers (mantissa64+exponent16), FPCW FPSW abridged physical FTW; segment caches/tables; CR0/2/3/4; all eight DR slots; MXCSR and XMM. Target-sized fields require actual system-i386 versus system-x86_64 identity.
cpu_vmstate.optional_subsection: cpu/fpop_ip_dp version1 holds uint16 fpop, uint64 fpip, uint64 fpdp. needed iff any nonzero. Absence is only semantically meaningful after full valid version-bound section parsing; no heuristic scan or guessed zero.
cpu_vmstate.fop_model_gap: Serialized env.fpop exists, but reviewed TCG x87 translator/helper does not update opcode alongside FIP/FDP; no claim of architectural accuracy.

cpuid_and_fxsave.conclusion: Cannot justify missing fields as architectural zero using these features. Actual emulated CPUID still must be measured. The x87 translator updates fpcs/fpds; do_xsave_fpu writes zero pointer blocks regardless, so guest FXSAVE is not a lossless fallback.

bounded_acquisition_candidates.preferred_if_further_development_needed: QMP xen-save-devices-state with explicit live:false, while stopped, writes non-iterable device state including CPU without RAM/block images. Not called by this audit. File is not CPU-only and its size remains device-dependent. No complete57 gain because FCS/FDS omitted.
bounded_acquisition_candidates.cautions: Default live:true can inactivate block storage when already stopped. Preserve stop epoch, bound output and verify state; no destination load or guest helper injection. Validate actual command availability and source behavior before use.
bounded_acquisition_candidates.migration_tcp: Streaming receiver could parse/discard RAM pages without persisting 4GiB, but stream is version/device-dependent and not a sequence of arbitrary length-prefixed chunks. Never scan raw byte strings for cpu section. CPU is saved at final stopped phase; streaming discard still incurs migration work. Not implemented or tested.
bounded_acquisition_candidates.resume: Upstream runstate allows POSTMIGRATE->RUNNING, but migration completion leaves source POSTMIGRATE; block reactivation and guest clock/liveness require actual bounded experiment. Static allowed transition does not prove successful cont or native resource continuity.

acceptance_boundary: TCG executes translated guest instructions. A future real Windows guest process may own Windows resources, but this audit proves neither original-game compatibility nor required native ownership/lifetime. TCG CPU semantics and missing fullstate prevent declaring full native acceptance. No parser, VM, tests, commits or guest input were created by this subtask.

evidence.retention: Bounded source excerpts plus manifests retained below 2MiB. Equal files across versions deduplicated by local_path. No guest dumps or full source archive. Empty failed version lookup directory only; no pre-existing files removed.

hmp_expression.source_version: upstream v11.1.0; actual publisher commit remains unauthenticated
hmp_expression.route: monitor/hmp.c gdb_get_register reads existing GDB descriptor via gdb_read_register. Fallback x86_monitor_defs in target/i386/cpu.c contains only six segment .limit values and pc; i386_sysemu_ops has no monitor_get_register override.
hmp_expression.conclusion: fpip/fpdp/fpcs/fpds/fpop have no separate monitor accessor. Matching GDB fioff/fooff/fiseg/foseg/fop names retain their placeholder-zero semantics.
